% A section right after a chapter has only the chapter's space below it,
% as LaTeX's \@startsection adds no space above a heading while
% \if@nobreak holds, also with a \label between them.
\documentclass{report}
\begin{document}
\chapter{First}
\section{After the chapter}
Some text in the section.
\chapter*{Unnumbered}\label{unnumbered}
\section*{After the label}
Some text in the section.
\end{document}
